_comment: Task timers (engine/tasks.js): how long charting work keeps a student busy, in sim seconds. Intervention and assessment-tool durations live on their catalog entries (durationSec); MAR actions here. A patient (taskDurations) or a scenario (settings.taskDurations) can override any: keys are an intervention id, tool:<toolId> or mar:<result>. allowedWhileBusy: chart work a busy student can still do at once (call lights, alarm silencing, priority, notes and orders aren't tasks, so they're always allowed). Instructor to confirm (SPEC §14).
